name: Red5 Cloud
tagline: Red5 Cloud is a fully managed, globally distributed cloud-based streaming platform designed to deliver high-quality video, audio, and data
description: Red5 Cloud is a fully managed, globally distributed cloud-based streaming platform designed to deliver high-quality video, audio, and data. It enables developers, startups, and enterprises to stream content with low or ultra-low latency based on their requirements, ensuring seamless and interactive experiences across various applications such as live event production, sports and news broadcasting, gaming, live auction and ecommerce, video conferencing and webinars, telemedicine, house of worship
